propositions: CodeHealthConfig.analyzers field is inert: never populated in production, only monkeypatched in tests, advertises a capability that has zero read sites outside config plumbing

The per-language analyzer dispatch seam (resolve_analyzer, analyze_or_unavailable, ANALYZERS registry, load_lizard) was abandoned in favor of direct composition and remains dead code with zero production callers

The dispatch is not viable as designed: analyze_or_unavailable calls analyzer.analyze with keyword argument 'languages', but scc_loc.analyze's second parameter is named 'scan_roots', causing TypeError at runtime
Removing the analyzers config field requires a tombstone registry entry (REBAR_CODE_HEALTH_ANALYZERS) to prevent silent drops and provide honest warnings to operators with legacy config

AnalyzerResult protocol and Analyzer interface must be retained for use by git_metrics.py composition path; the live structural analysis functions (_scc_analysis, _lizard_analysis, _jscpd_analysis) are unaffected
